facts.fact: After ch 30 Rohan went down the lowland Taravan road to report the Under-Cairn to the queen's clerks, and returned to the Shilak post on day 48 by that road; Ila held Harish's story until she could tell him face to face. Supersedes F782's 'Saddle road'.

The queen's condition: Neshar's seat must keep Pritam held, and the council's pairs walk every mapped way so no one can walk him out. Supersedes F781's 'recapture' wording; sets up the ch 32 escape as a breach of this bargain.
